notes.title: Welcome to the Meow Meow Invasion Steam Community
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
We’re Bitcover, an indie team bringing you Meow Meow Invasion—a chaotic action game where you, a parasite-infected cat, must battle your way to total domination! 😼💥

We’re super excited to welcome you all to this community! This is the place where we’ll share updates, behind-the-scenes peeks, and of course, hear your thoughts as we continue developing the game. Your feedback means the world to us, and we’d love for you to be part of this journey!

[h1][b]What is Meow Meow Invasion?[/b][/h1]
🐾 A fast-paced action game with intense battles
🔥 Absurdly fun combat and chaotic power-ups
😼 A world where cats reign supreme (with a little help from some… unusual parasites)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312680/84c8a4a2bd7443222ff5064e47bbb279ecca2cb7.jpg[/img]

We’re still in development, but you can already try out the demo and let us know what you think! Your support helps us make the game even better.

Join the Chaos!
💬 Drop by the discussions and share your thoughts!

Thank you for being here—now let’s take over the world, one infected cat at a time! 🦠🐱🔥

notes.title: Demo v0.3.56 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]General updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] SFX/BGM improvements
[*] UI/UX improvements
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Kitties system:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the spaceship will drop a kitty box every 5 levels of Meow
[*] Kitties rarity from the kitty box will be determined based on Meow's level
[*] Now the unique weapon and active skill of Beck can be evolved if you have 4 orange unions
[/list]
[b]Bosses:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add boss HP bar
[*] Increase the size of all bosses
[*] Temporarily remove the laser dog boss due to its overwhelming difficulty
[/list]
[b]Buffs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Critical rate: 2% > 5%
[*] Attack Speed: 2% > 5%
[/list]
